params.prompt:
VIYA STRICT REGISTERED SPRITE EDGE REPAIR. Edit ONLY the FIRST reference: existing right-facing running frame 00, a 400x496 RGBA game sprite. Keep exactly its running pose, silhouette, scale, framing, origin, hair strands, hands, rifle angle, boot positions, and all interior character details. Second reference is idle identity/material guidance ONLY; third and fourth are neighbouring run frames 01 and 10 for continuity ONLY. Do not change the pose to any other reference.
Repair the incorrect pale white/gray matte residue hugging the outer hair, loose strands, exposed arm, crimson cape edges, inner-leg opening, boots, and firearm. Repaint contaminated outline pixels with the correct adjoining dark-brown hair, crimson cloth, leather, skin and metal colours. The matte came from a removed white background and is NOT a rim light. Remove it without deleting fine hair/cloth tips. Preserve genuine ivory blouse, skin highlights, brass/gold ornament, warm hair highlights, and red runes. No new costume, no mirrored asymmetry, no redesign, no extra limbs, no white stroke or glow.
Output ONE corrected frame on REAL transparent alpha. Exact 400x496 full canvas, same pixel registration and fixed ground/muzzle anchors. No background, no checkerboard pixels, no shadow, no scenery, no captions. Pixel-locked silhouette boundary edit; preserve image interior outside the narrow contaminated edge. Keep sharp painted dark-fantasy anime rendering, existing mature adult face and proportions. This is a restoration of an existing animation frame, not a new character illustration.
